entities.summary: Dhovemi, a notable figure in the history of Maldives, associated with Islamic Conversion and Sultanate (1153–1343). Preceded by Conversion to Islam and King Dhovemi converts to Islam and establishes the Maldive Sultanate. Their legacy influenced Ibn Battuta and Early Sultanate.
